# Cache-Aside & Two-Level L1/L2 Memory Architecture

Two-tier caching: in-process L1 cache (Moka/Caffeine, sub-microsecond) backed by distributed L2 cache (Redis), with bus invalidation.

## Invariants
- INVALIDATE_L1_VIA_PUBSUB_ON_L2_WRITE
- SHORT_L1_TTL_TO_BOUND_INCONSISTENCY
- LOCAL_CACHE_MAX_MEMORY_BOUNDS
